source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1854 consistently describes the front UBB sensor and Web thresholds. The SOL procedure belongs to a distinct duplicate-code row and is not an internal conflict in this variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive front-zone sensor check is identifiable. Placement, airflow meaning and thresholds are supplyable project inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Quarantines unrelated interactive-console coverage, adds physical/airflow provenance and ensures front, rear and Web threshold evidence remain atomic and complete.
independent_technical_reasoning: The code collision could cause either a false thermal result from SOL evidence or unsafe console interaction during a sensor review. Once the exact row is bound, the engineering distinction is spatial: a front probe often serves as ambient/inlet reference, whereas a rear probe includes system heat pickup. Board orientation and airflow must therefore govern the threshold set rather than adjacency or label alone.
